first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: A smoothly colored blue area beyond the horizon, lighter near the horizon.

entities.name: Dry Grassland
entities.identification: A light yellowish-brown ground surface occupying most of the frame, with visible clumps of grass, patches of bare soil, and rough light-and-dark textures.

entities.name: Scattered Trees and Shrubs
entities.identification: Scattered greenish-brown and light-brown clumps of vegetation on the grassland; the crowns nearby are larger, with elongated shadows on the ground.

entities.name: Dirt Road and Linear Track
entities.identification: Brown band-shaped paths among the grassland and locally approximately parallel linear tracks.

entities.name: Distant Long, Narrow Water Surface
entities.identification: A smooth, narrow blue-gray band of water in the distant view at the upper right of the frame, adjoining a light-colored shoreline and the ground surface.
